response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: The blank purpose code is stored as an empty or whitespace string, not NULL (the column is NOT NULL). It is grouped on its raw stored value as its own group. If both '' and ' ' exist, they would be two separate groups.
The amount > 2802 filter is applied before computing the per-purpose averages, and the overall figure is the unweighted mean of those per-purpose averages.
